'''C78 Division''' was a [[Division/Legends|division]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Army]]. C78 fielded [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]] and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|''Persuader''-class]] tanks, [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP gunships]] and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]]. Tank droids in this unit were more accurate in combat than the droids of [[H33 Division]].
